subject: Mobile Development
title: Apple Intelligence and Google Gemini Nano
description: A short lesson to help you apply Apple Intelligence and Google Gemini Nano.

hook.text: Apple Intelligence rewrites your emails. Gemini Nano summarizes your calls. AI is baked into the OS.

buildup.text: Both Apple and Google are embedding large language models directly into their mobile platforms.

discovery.text: These models run on dedicated Neural Processing Units — chips designed specifically for AI tasks.

twist.text: On-device LLMs are much smaller than GPT-4, trading capability for speed and privacy.

climax.text: AI at the OS level transforms the phone from a tool you use into an assistant that anticipates you.

punchline.text: Your phone's OS is becoming an AI assistant.

quiz.question: What hardware runs on-device AI models?
